name: io.github.ohneben/hubspot-mcp
description: HubSpot MCP server — the whole public API (1,000+ endpoints across CRM, CMS, Marketing, Automation, Commerce & more) as safety-categorized, hub/plan-aware tools (Docker + Streamable HTTP).

environment_variables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: HubSpot private-app access token (pat-...) from Settings -> Integrations -> Private Apps (an OAuth access token also works).

environment_variables.name: HUBSPOT_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: API host. Default https://api.hubapi.com; use https://api-eu1.hubapi.com for EU data residency portals.

environment_variables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Optional bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Empty = open (localhost only).
